question.problem: Express $\displaystyle\sum_{n=2}^{4} (2n-3)$ as a sum of three terms.
question.worked_solution:
The sum takes integer values of $n$ from $2$ to $4.$ So, we compute the terms for $n=2,3,4$ and write the sum, as follows:

$$
\eqalign{\displaystyle\sum_{n=2}^{4}(2n-3)&= \overbrace{\big(2(2)-3\big)}^{\large n\,=\,2}+\overbrace{\big(2(3)-3\big)}^{\large n\,=\,3}+\overbrace{\big(2(4)-3\big)}^{\large n\,=\,4} \[-5pt]
&=(4-3)+(6-3)+(8-3)\[5pt]
&=1+3+5	
	}
$$
